title: Rescue Plan
next_chapter_hook: After the Second Prince of the Imperial Dynasty obtained that false intelligence through the sect insider, his cold fingers tapped lightly on the Jade Slip—he decided to move against Chen Nian ahead of schedule.

text.content: When Chen Ji drew out the yellowed secret agreement from his breast, the gaze of Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly became profound—that chip, casually obtained three years ago, had now become the only key to reaching his father. Mo Xiansheng's wraith slowly solidified, his voice as calm as an ancient deep well: 'When Chen Xuan left this item, he already knew you would eventually reach this point. This is not coincidence, but fate.' Chen Ji's fingertips traced the cinnabar seal on the agreement, yet his heart was clear as a mirror—the so-called fate was merely a chess game arranged by the strong, and he was attempting to be the chess player.

dialogue.content: The ink shadow on the first page of the Tianji Record trembled slightly, and Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind: 'Since you have decided to use this trump card, you should know—the Second Prince of the Imperial Dynasty is no ordinary man. His informants are scattered across the three major sects, and those around you may not all be trustworthy.' Chen Ji lowered his gaze, a faint smile curling at his lips: 'Rest assured, Master, since I dare to set a trap, I have already anticipated that someone will fall into it.' His fingers tapped lightly on the edge of the agreement, as if waiting for some moment to ripen.

text.content: In the stone chamber of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds, candlelight flickered. Chen Ji spread the yellowed agreement open on the stone table, when Ye Qing's graceful figure emerged from the shadows, the unique cold aura of the Demonic Path permeating the air. She leaned against the stone pillar, her purple eyes swirling with ethereal light: 'Master Chen summons me in the deep night—could it be that the time to rescue your father and sister has finally arrived?' Chen Ji raised his gaze, his eyes as calm as a deep pool: 'The time has come, but before that, there is another piece that must be removed.' Ye Qing raised an eyebrow, approaching with interest.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji drew a bronze mirror from his sleeve and tossed it gently into the air. The mirror's surface rippled, revealing a blurred figure. He said coldly: 'Three days ago I sensed something amiss—the rescue plan's route intelligence leaked twice. I've been waiting, waiting for this nail to reveal itself.' The figure in the mirror gradually sharpened—it was actually a usually taciturn patron from the alliance. Ye Qing narrowed her purple eyes, a playful smile forming at her lips: 'So this was bait you deliberately set. Quite a masterful move, Master Chen.' Chen Ji returned the mirror to his sleeve, his gaze deep and dark: 'The chess game is set; time to close the net.'

text.content: Yet before Chen Ji's words had even finished, the image in the bronze mirror suddenly distorted. His pupils contracted slightly—the reflection was no longer that person, but a completely different face. It was an unremarkable middle-aged cultivator, his features so ordinary that he'd be impossible to find once lost in a crowd. Ye Qing's smile froze; she abruptly straightened up, her voice sharp: 'Substitution technique? What boldness!' Chen Ji's expression grew heavy, his fingers tightening slightly: 'I've fallen for the cicada's escape. That patron was merely a decoy—the real insider is someone else... and this person has been following me for at least half a year.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, his eyes flashing with brilliant light. He stared at the ordinary face in the bronze mirror and slowly spoke: 'I know who you are.' The person in the mirror also slightly curled his lips upward, as if responding to his gaze. Chen Ji said word by word: 'Under the Second Prince of the Imperial Dynasty, there exists a secret guard organization called 'Mirror Shadows.' Its members all master the art of skin-changing, able to transform into anyone. You are one of them, aren't you?' The image in the bronze mirror suddenly shattered, dissolving into scattered light. Ye Qing drew a sharp breath: 'The Second Prince of the Imperial Dynasty... he planted a nail beside you long ago?' Chen Ji returned the bronze mirror to his sleeve, his voice low: 'Since this person is his chess piece, following this thread will lead us to bigger fish.'

choice.prompt: The insider's identity is clear; Chen Ji decides the next move

choices.description: Deliberately let the insider pass false intelligence, drawing the Second Prince's attention in the wrong direction, buying time for the real rescue.
choices.visible_cost: Requires 3 points of Heavenly Fate for foresight calculation
choices.visible_reward: The Second Prince will act according to the false intelligence; our side can arrange things at leisure
choices.risk_hint: If the false intelligence is exposed, the Second Prince will move against Chen Nian ahead of schedule

text.content: A slight smile curled at Chen Ji's lips, a calculating gleam flickering in his eyes. He turned to Ye Qing, his voice steady: 'Since he's the Second Prince's informant, let him continue to be 'conscientious.' I want him to deliver a message to the Second Prince through his own mouth—three days later, a great opportunity will emerge at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds.' Ye Qing understood, her purple eyes radiant: 'You're... inviting the guest into the jar?' Chen Ji nodded, his tone indifferent yet chilling: 'He wants to fish me out; I'll send him a lure. Only this bait has a hook hidden inside.'

result_nodes.description: Directly expose the insider, use thunderous methods to deter other hidden forces, letting the Second Prince know that Tianqing Sect is not soft persimmon to be squeezed.
result_nodes.visible_cost: May alarm the snake; the Second Prince will accelerate his plans
result_nodes.risk_hint: The Second Prince, desperate, makes reckless moves; Chen Nian's situation becomes even more dangerous

text.content: A cold light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes; his tone suddenly turned icy: 'No need for such complications.' He abruptly raised his hand, a beam of Spiritual Light shooting toward the corner of the stone chamber. That spot was clearly empty, yet suddenly a muffled grunt echoed—the insider's concealment technique was forcibly broken, his form tumbling out狼狈ly. Black energy swirled in Ye Qing's sleeves as she was about to strike, but Chen Ji raised his hand to stop her. He slowly walked toward the trembling insider, looking down: 'Go back and tell your master, Chen Ji awaits his arrival. Since he wants to play, I'll play along to the end.' The insider's face turned ashen as his form dissolved into flowing light and fled into the Void.

result_nodes.text: Leveraging Power: Luring the Snake from Its Hole
result_nodes.description: Deliberately reveal part of the true intelligence to the insider, while secretly notifying Elder Ling Yuan to 'assist,' using a knife to kill, reaping the渔翁's benefits.
result_nodes.visible_cost: Requires revealing part of the plan to Elder Ling Yuan; loses some initiative
result_nodes.visible_reward: The Second Prince and Elder Ling Yuan fight it out; our side reaps the benefits
result_nodes.risk_hint: Ling Yuan might take the opportunity to turn against us, causing even greater trouble.

text.content: Chen Ji pondered for a moment, then suddenly let out a soft laugh: 'There is one person who wants the Second Prince to suffer even more than I do.' Ye Qing raised an eyebrow: 'You mean... Ling Yuan?' Chen Ji nodded, his voice dropped to a whisper: 'The old sect master and the Second Prince have long had grudges. One represents the conservative faction of Tianqing Sect, the other a scheming ambition of the imperial court. If I leak the 'true information' of the rescue plan to the old sect master, and let the sect insider 'accidentally' discover it...' Ye Qing picked up: 'They will become suspicious of each other, even come to blows.' Chen Ji glanced at her approvingly: 'The Holy Maiden is indeed clever. However, this move requires extremely precise timing control.'

After hearing Chen Ji's complete plan, Ye Qing's purple eyes sparkled with keen interest, then revealed a meaningful smile: 'Chen Gongzi, what excellent scheming. Turning a scheme against its creator, killing with a borrowed knife—this连环套娃 of strategies would make even the Second Prince himself take a major fall.' She suddenly leaned forward, lowering her voice: 'But are you certain there are no flaws? You said that in three days, an opportunity will emerge at the Back Mountain. What if the Second Prince sends his trusted aide to investigate...' Chen Ji raised a hand to stop her words, a confident curve forming at the corner of his lips: 'He will come. Not because he believes, but because he cannot afford not to. The secrets of Tianqing Sect are worth him gambling everything.'

dialogue.content: Suddenly, footsteps echoed outside the stone chamber. Chen Ji's gaze sharpened slightly. The visitor was precisely that 'Patron' he had named earlier. The man looked flustered, and the moment he entered, he knelt on the ground: 'Chen Gongzi, this is bad! The Second Prince's people have already made their move—they've attacked Miss Chen Nian ahead of schedule!' Ye Qing's expression changed dramatically, demonic energy swirling in her sleeves. Chen Ji, however, remained completely unmoved, even a hint of a smile curling at his lips. He spoke unhurriedly: 'You've come at the perfect time. I just have a secret letter that I need you to deliver to His Highness the Second Prince.' The Patron's body stiffened, a flash of panic flickering in his eyes. Chen Ji drew a jade slip from his sleeve and handed it to him: 'This is the latest intelligence I've gathered—the complete defensive layout of Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds. With this, His Highness the Second Prince can advance unimpeded.'

choice.prompt: Chen Ji handed the 'intelligence' to the sect insider, finally confirming the strategy.

choices.description: Watching the sect insider depart with the false intelligence, officially initiating the counter-trap strategy.
choices.visible_reward: Plan successful. The Second Prince will act according to our预设路线.
choices.risk_hint: Need to wait three days to see the outcome.

dialogue.content: The Patron trembling as he received the jade slip, nodded repeatedly before turning into escaping light and vanishing into the night. Ye Qing watched him leave, then softly said: 'You are dancing on the blade's edge. What if he discovers the jade slip is fake...' Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, gazing toward the distant imperial capital. His voice was calm yet carried absolute confidence: 'He will not discover. Because everything on this jade slip is real—only the sequence of the defensive layout has been swapped by me. In three days, when the Second Prince happily steps into the trap I prepared for him, it will all be too late.' Ye Qing stared at him, suddenly realizing she had never truly seen through this man.

result_nodes.description: Besides the false intelligence, arrange Ye Qing to secretly track the sect insider, ensuring the intelligence delivery is foolproof.
result_nodes.visible_cost: Requires consuming 2 points of Heavenly Fate.
result_nodes.visible_reward: Double insurance ensures the plan proceeds smoothly, while also allowing us to grasp the Second Prince's next moves.
result_nodes.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate is precious. It should not be used unless absolutely necessary.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji pondered for a moment, then suddenly turned to Ye Qing: 'Trouble the Holy Maiden to make a secret trip. After the Patron delivers the jade slip to the Second Prince, there will certainly be a response. I need to know the Second Prince's very first reaction after reading the intelligence.' Ye Qing slightly nodded, her form already beginning to dissipate: 'Rest assured, my Demonic Path mist can even conceal the aura of the Tianji Record. The imperial court's spies are nothing.' Just as she was about to completely vanish, Chen Ji suddenly spoke: 'There is one more matter.' Ye Qing's form paused. Chen Ji stood with his back to her, his voice low: 'If the intelligence leaks, if Chen Nian suffers any harm... You know the consequences.' Ye Qing was silent for a moment, then softly said: 'She will be unharmed. I swear on the honor of the Demonic Path Holy Maiden.'

text.content: The stone chamber returned to silence, only the candle flames crackling. Chen Ji stood alone before the table, his fingertips gently rubbing against the yellowed secret agreement. Mo Xiansheng's phantom appeared once more, the old man's voice carrying a hint of relief: 'This move of yours is more steady than this old man anticipated. However...' Chen Ji raised his eyes: 'However what?' Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment, then sighed: 'The closer you get to the truth, the more you will realize you are merely a piece on a much larger chessboard. The Second Prince of the imperial court is like this, Tianqing Sect is like this... Even this old man is like this.' Chen Ji's gaze sharpened slightly, suddenly asking: 'Then what about the Eye of Heavenly Providence? Is it also on the chessboard?' Mo Xiansheng's figure trembled violently. After a long while, he said: 'That question, you are not yet at a time to know.'

At the same time, thousands of miles away in the imperial capital of the dynasty, in the magnificent Crown Prince's mansion, a tall figure stood by the window. The man wore a black dragon robe, his handsome features carrying a sinister aura. He was precisely the Second Prince of the dynasty—the true mastermind behind the Heavenly Fate Key plan. A court attendant hurried in, presenting the jade slip. The Second Prince received the jade slip, his spiritual sense probing within, and slowly curved his lips into a meaningful smile: 'Interesting... Chen Ji, you think this prince would be foolish enough to walk directly into your trap?' He casually tossed the jade slip onto the table, cold light flickering in his eyes: 'Issue the order. Move against Chen Nian ahead of schedule. This prince wants to see whether you, Chen Ji, are the chess player, or merely a chess piece.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly felt a wave of inexplicable palpitations, as if something extremely important was slipping beyond his control. His eyes snapped open, fingers rapidly掐诀—the Tianji Record fragment in his embrace grew slightly warm, emanating a warning fluctuation. He saw a blurry image: a cage of cold iron, Chen Nian with eyes tightly closed, the surrounding sealing formation runes rapidly operating. And the jailer guarding her had robes embroidered with the dynasty's emblem! Chen Ji's expression changed drastically. He roared in a low voice: 'Not good! The Second Prince has moved ahead of schedule!' His fist smashed onto the stone table, cracks spreading everywhere. Stay calm! He forced himself to stay calm—panic was the greatest enemy. The Second Prince's move was clearly forcing him to expose his hidden cards ahead of time!

choice.prompt: The Second Prince moved against Chen Nian ahead of schedule. Chen Ji faces an urgent decision.

choices.description: Immediately gather all available forces, forcefully assault the dynasty camp to rescue Chen Nian, regardless of the cost.
choices.visible_cost: Suffer heavy losses, possibly exposing all hidden cards.
choices.visible_reward: Rescue Chen Nian at the fastest speed.
choices.risk_hint: Fighting a stone with an egg, the odds are bleak.

text.content: Chen Ji rose abruptly, swept his sleeves, and the formation seals of the secret chamber shattered open. He was about to send a signal when he suddenly froze—A direct assault? With their current forces, to strike the Imperial Army's camp? Setting aside the Imperial City's elite guards' strength, the Second Prince's hidden masters alone could annihilate them. He closed his eyes and took a deep breath. "No... there is another way." Chen Ji murmured, his fingers forming seals once more. The Tianji Record Fragment materialized in his palm, emanating a faint glow. He would look again—even if it cost another 5 Heavenly Fate Points, he had to see that sole thread of survival. "

result_nodes.description: Proactively contact the Second Prince, offer to trade himself for Chen Nian's freedom, to resolve this matter
result_nodes.visible_cost: Lose freedom, become a prisoner of the Second Prince
result_nodes.visible_reward: Chen Nian temporarily safe, buying time for negotiation

dialogue.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, fingers flying through seals. When he opened them again, the swirling light of the Tianji Record reflected in his pupils. He saw an image—the Second Prince seated in a luxurious carriage, a Jade Slip displaying his location. Chen Ji coldly laughed: "A fine 'inviting the guest into the urn'... But since you wish to see me, I shall see you." He lifted his brush, writing a few lines on a blank paper: "The appointment at the Back Mountain three days hence is changed to tonight. At the Hour of Midnight, the Pavilion Ten Li West of the City. I have what you want, and you should return what I desire." He folded the paper into a crane, infused it with spiritual energy, and released it. The paper crane pierced through the night sky, flying toward the Imperial Army's camp. Chen Ji murmured: "Second Prince, you wish to see my cards? Then let me show you—and I hope after seeing them, you can still smile."

result_nodes.description: Pretend to go negotiate, actually split forces secretly, letting Ye Qing infiltrate the camp to rescue Chen Nian
result_nodes.visible_cost: Requires Ye Qing to risk venturing deep behind enemy lines
result_nodes.risk_hint: If exposed, Ye Qing will fall into grave danger

dialogue.content: Chen Ji pondered for a moment, then curved his lips into a meaningful smile. He lifted his brush and wrote on the paper: "The appointment at the Back Mountain three days hence is changed to tonight. At the Hour of Midnight, the Pavilion Ten Li West of the City. I have what you want, and you should return what I desire." The paper crane flew away on beating wings. Meanwhile, he secretly activated a transmission talisman, whispering: "Ye Qing, the plan has changed. Infiltrate the Imperial Army's camp immediately. Enter through the western secret passage. Chen Nian is imprisoned in the northeastern corner of the cells. There are at least three Golden Core stage experts guarding her." Ye Qing's voice came through the transmission talisman: "You've gone mad? That's the Imperial Army's camp!" Chen Ji's tone was calm: "That's why I'll personally go to stall the Second Prince. Remember, speed is essential. After rescuing the person, withdraw immediately. Don't look back."

result_nodes.content: It was deep night. Chen Ji walked alone out of the stone chamber, gazing up at the starry sky. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul appeared behind him but said nothing. The wind brushed against his robes, bringing a chill. Chen Ji murmured softly: "Nian'er, your brother has come to rescue you." His hand slowly clenched, knuckles turning white. Three years ago, he had watched helplessly as Chen Nian was taken away by the Holy Sect's people. For three years, he survived as a 'waste' in this world, enduring humiliation and biding his time, all for this moment. Now, the chess game was set, and victory or defeat would soon be decided. He didn't know what awaited him, but one thing he was absolutely certain of—no matter whether ahead lay dragon's pool or tiger's lair, he would charge right in.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly resonated in Chen Ji's mind, carrying an unprecedented solemnity: "Chen Ji, do you understand what the Heavenly Fate Lock Key signifies?" Chen Ji's steps faltered slightly: "I would gladly hear the details." Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a long while before slowly saying: "The Heavenly Fate Lock Key is the key to opening the Gate of Heavenly Fate. And behind that gate..." His voice abruptly stopped, as if some taboo forbade utterance. Chen Ji pressed: "What lies behind it?" Mo Xiansheng sighed: "Power that transcends this world. That is precisely why the Heavenly Eye of Destiny seeks to control the Lock Key. If you rescue Chen Nian, you will completely expose yourself before the Heavenly Eye of Destiny. At that time, both you and I will face utter destruction." Upon hearing this, Chen Ji did not retreat. Instead, a serene smile appeared on his face: "Sir, I was born ready to face death. If I cannot protect my loved ones, what use is this Heavenly Fate?"

text.content: In the Imperial Army's central command tent. The Second Prince received the paper crane, unfolded the note, and a playful gleam flickered in his eyes. He clapped lightly, laughing: "Chen Ji, oh Chen Ji, you certainly have composure. Unfortunately, you underestimated this Prince." He handed the note to a aide beside him: "Transmit the order—set up an ambush with three hundred elite soldiers around the pavilion. Additionally..." He paused, cold light suddenly flashing in his eyes, "Send someone to the Tianqing Sect to invite that old fogey Ling Yuan as well. Tell him this Prince has important matters to discuss." The aide departed with the order. The Second Prince gazed at the heavy night beyond the tent, his smile growing increasingly sinister: "Chen Ji, you wish to be a chess player? This Prince shall see how much weight you carry. After tonight, the Tianqing Sect... no, the entire cultivation world, shall be reshuffled."

Near the Hour of Midnight, the moon hid behind clouds. Outside the Pavilion Ten Li West of the City, Chen Ji stood alone. He had changed into a plain white robe, particularly conspicuous in the night. The night wind stirred his garments, carrying a desolate feeling. In the distance, footsteps approached, and torchlight illuminated the darkness. The Second Prince's carriage slowly arrived, the curtain lifted, and that handsome yet sinister face appeared in Chen Ji's sight. Their gazes met in mid-air, as if sparks were flying. Chen Ji clasped his hands in greeting, his voice calm: "Your Highness the Second Prince, I've long heard of you." The Second Prince chuckled lightly: "Chen Ji, long time no see. This Prince has watched you rise step by step from atrash to today... You truly haven't disappointed me."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stared directly into the Second Prince's eyes without flinching: "Your Highness flatters. May I ask if my sister Chen Nian is well?" The Second Prince clapped his hands, and attendants led out a prison carriage. The curtain opened—Chen Nian huddled in the cage, her face pale, yet still lifting her head defiantly. When she saw Chen Ji, tears welled in her eyes. Chen Ji's heart clenched tightly, but his expression remained unmoved. He took a deep breath and said solemnly: "What does Your Highness desire?" The Second Prince stepped down from the carriage, slowly approaching Chen Ji, his voice cold as a venomous snake: "What this Prince wants is very simple—the Tianji Record Fragment. Hand it over. Your father's life, your sister's life, even your own life, can all be spared." Chen Ji suddenly laughed, his laughter echoing in the night wind, carrying an indescribable mockery.

text.content: The Second Prince frowned slightly: "What are you laughing at?" Chen Ji收起 his laughter, his gaze sharp as a blade: "I laugh at Your Highness's grand appetite. The Tianji Record is a supreme treasure from antiquity. Your Highness opens your mouth and demands it—isn't that rather presumptuous?" He paused, then shifted topics: "However, since Your Highness sincerely desires it, perhaps Chen could consider it. But..." He raised his hand, pointing toward the distant torchlight, "Shouldn't Your Highness withdraw those three hundred hidden soldiers first? We're conducting a transaction—making such a show of force makes Your Highness seem lacking in sincerity." The Second Prince narrowed his eyes, studying Chen Ji for a long while, then suddenly burst into laughter: "Excellent! Excellent! Chen Ji, you are indeed no ordinary figure." He waved his hand, and the hidden troops on all sides slowly withdrew. In the pavilion, only two people remained in confrontation. The moonlight broke through the clouds, illuminating Chen Ji's calm features.
